summary.text: Tomb Earth is one of the ten earths. In Yellow Earth Great World its mound at the center is Paradise Earth's Sacred Tomb.

claims.text: Fang Yuan recalls that in the previous life’s five hundred years, after the five regions became one and the earth veins merged, people called the resulting unique terrains the ten earths, listing Tomb Earth among them with Earth Abyss, Earth Trench, Earth Tunnel, Earth Cave, Earth Prison, Production Earth, Flying Earth, Formation Earth, and Earth Treasury.

Southern Border’s Paradise Earth true inheritance describes the ten earths in detail and states that they can bear the task of being earth vein nodes. At that time Fang Yuan can create only half of the ten earths and cannot yet form Tomb Earth. Narration says the formation of Tomb Earth is shrouded in mystery, even Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable could not see through it. Gu Immortals can revive in this area. Tomb Earth’s tombstone has information path ability and seems to extract and condense all the information of the Gu Immortal’s life from the River of Time. The greater the reputation, the more detailed the writings, which seem to help revival.
Meng Qiu Zhen weighs how Tu clan might have risen in the previous life’s chaotic war and includes among the possibilities that Tu village’s members revived in Tomb Earth.

At the center of Yellow Earth Great World, Fang Yuan sees a huge flat mound and identifies it at once as Tomb Earth of the Ten Earths, calling it such a huge tomb. The tombstone reads Tomb of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable. When Lu Wei Yin and Fang Yuan arrive, the tomb emits a grand pillar of light, and Yellow Earth Great World’s people roar that the Sacred Tomb is shining and their sage has arrived. Narration also calls it the Paradise Earth Sacred Tomb at the center of Yellow Earth Great World, openly seen to the Gu Immortals of the three worlds.
At Paradise Earth’s Sacred Tomb, Yellow Earth Gu Immortals kneel to greet the arriving sages. They are beasts, plants, or other non-human forms, with no pure humans among them.

Lu Wei Yin tells Fang Yuan that even if Yellow Earth Great World cannot win the immediate battle, defending the Sacred Tomb matters so that during the final battle Paradise Earth can revive and their battle strength can reign above the other two forces.

Lu Wei Yin points Fang Yuan to Paradise Earth’s Sacred Tomb as Northern Plains’ Paradise Earth true inheritance before them. Fang Yuan says the tomb of Paradise Earth contains extraordinary profundity and that he has not gotten useful leads yet.

Lu Wei Yin says Heavenly Court transferred a portion of its immortal graveyard into Crazed Demon Cave, and that this immortal graveyard was created there by using Tomb Earth they collected. At the crucial moment, slumbering experts in history would awaken with terrifying strength.

Fang Yuan comprehends profundities of Paradise Earth’s tomb until he can create his own Tomb Earth as a huge graveyard in the sovereign immortal aperture to act as an earth vein node. Luck inspection shows Paradise Earth’s tomb with immense luck resembling a yellow soil mountain, unmoving and dense.

Fang Yuan states that from comprehending Paradise Earth’s tomb he can now create his own Tomb Earth, and that using Tomb Earth he can make Gu Immortals revive, with even the Immortal Gu they had when alive produced alongside the person.
